summary: Inline money formatting (`/ 100`, `.toFixed`, `Intl.NumberFormat`) in app/ and components/ now fails lint.
Why: inline formats round differently from the CSV export.
Nothing visible changes; 0 existing violations. Bad example `(c / 100).toFixed(2)` in a page fails; `formatAmount(c)` passes.
